sources.title: Your Interview / Preparing for your credibility interview | Middlesex University
quotes: Why do you want to study in the UK?
Why did you choose your institution?
What other institutions did you consider?
Why did you choose this course?
What other courses did you consider?
What do you want to do after graduation?
How will this qualification help you?
How much are the tuition fees?
What qualification will you receive when you graduate?
How will you pay for your studies/living costs?
How much will your accommodation cost?
Are you planning to work while you are in the UK?
sources.notes: Fetched. Describes the UKVI credibility interview: 'The interview should last around 10 to 20 minutes. It can be done by video conference with an interviewer in the UK, by telephone or face-to-face at a visa application centre, a High Commission or an Embassy.' 'The interview is not recorded, but your answers are written down.' Checks 'You have carefully thought about your study and why you want to come here' and 'Your English is good enough for you to study in the UK so you will be expected to answer the questions without an interpreter.' No CAS Shield/Enroly mention.
